missing.note: 702 network fragments with fewer than 20 junctions (501.0 km) are not run. 70 surveyed drains lack an invert level or size and never enter the graph, and survey lines that do not meet another drain within 10 m stay as separate fragments. Zones below are sorted by the share of surveyed km modelled.

caveats: Rain is a synthetic storm, uniform over the whole city. It is not a radar nowcast.
Hydraulic parameters are the defaults. Calibration on 2015 records did not beat them (results/calibration.json).
Streets are 1D channels along the surveyed drains, not a 2D grid. Depths over 1 m are pooling artifacts of a 30 m DEM.
Outfalls are free: canal and river levels, tides and backwater are not modelled, and 2015 flooding also had canal and river backwater.
Components are modelled separately; water cannot pass between fragments.
